overview: The Medford City Council approved funding for road resurfacing, stadium turf, and the Medford Connects program, and ordained a zoning amendment for inclusionary housing fractional payments. The Council also voted to support striking Encore casino workers, approved a one-month Law Department budget extension amid ongoing disputes with the Mayor, and resolved to object to the administration's refusal to publicize council ward meetings.

items.title: Ward 5 Neighborhood Meeting Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting residents to the Ward 5 Neighborhood Meeting on October 20th.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for K9 Seamus
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences on the passing of Medford Police Department K9 Seamus.

items.title: Fire Prevention Day Invitation
items.summary: Approved a resolution inviting residents to the Medford Fire Department's Fire Prevention Day on October 10th.

items.title: September 15th Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of the September 15th city council meeting.

items.title: Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee Report
items.summary: Approved the committee report discussing summer newsletters and upcoming neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: Zoning Consultant Request for Proposals
items.summary: Referred the zoning consultant draft RFP to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: City Website Improvement Resolution
items.summary: Referred a resolution regarding city website improvements to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Support for Striking Encore Workers
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the striking Encore Boston Harbor workers represented by Unite Here Local 26 and Teamsters Local 25.

items.title: November 3rd, 2026 General Election Call
items.summary: Approved the call for the upcoming general election following public comment regarding voter protection under the state PROTECT Act.

items.title: General Election Warrant
items.summary: Approved the warrant for the November 3rd, 2026 general election.

items.title: Capital and General Stabilization Fund Appropriations
items.summary: Approved appropriations of $1.3 million for road resurfacing, $1 million for Hormel Stadium turf replacement, and $40,000 for the Medford Connects program.

items.title: Grant of Location for North Street and Walkman Court
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid and Verizon to replace and relocate joint-owned utility poles on North Street.

items.title: Inclusionary Housing Fractional Payment Zoning Amendment
items.summary: Approved a zoning amendment allowing developers to make fractional payments to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund when required affordable housing calculations result in less than half a unit.

items.title: Law Department Appropriations Response Paper
items.summary: Tabled the council's response to law department appropriations after scheduling the Fire Chief to attend a future meeting to discuss litigation mitigation.

items.title: Supplemental Law Department Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a reduced supplemental appropriation to fund the Law Department for one month through the end of October.

items.title: Resolution Objecting to Publicity Refusal for Ward Meetings
items.summary: Approved a resolution objecting to the Mayor's refusal to publicize the council's neighborhood ward meetings and calling for meeting listings to be restored on the city website.

items.title: Private Ways Liability Adoption Resolution
items.summary: Referred an order to place the adoption of state private way maintenance and liability laws before voters to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: Police Chief Search Funding Request
items.summary: Tabled a $35,000 stabilization fund request for the police chief search.

items.title: Food Truck Permit for Trolley Dogs
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for Trolley Dogs to operate at the Brooks Elementary School Fall Fest.
